name: icon-converter
title: Icon Converter
description: Convert icons and images between SVG, PNG, JPG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, ICO and PDF. Runs entirely on your computer, with no uploads and no limits.
author: filippo_brogi

commands.name: svg-to-png
commands.title: SVG to PNG
commands.description: Render SVG files as PNG images with transparency, at any size.

commands.name: svg-to-jpg
commands.title: SVG to JPG
commands.description: Render SVG files as JPG images on a solid background.

commands.name: svg-to-webp
commands.title: SVG to WebP
commands.description: Render SVG files as WebP images for the web.

commands.name: svg-to-pdf
commands.title: SVG to PDF
commands.description: Turn SVG files into print-ready vector PDF documents.

commands.name: png-to-svg
commands.title: PNG to SVG
commands.description: Vectorize PNG images by tracing them into SVG shapes.

commands.name: jpg-to-svg
commands.title: JPG to SVG
commands.description: Vectorize JPG images by tracing them into SVG shapes.

commands.name: webp-to-svg
commands.title: WebP to SVG
commands.description: Vectorize WebP images by tracing them into SVG shapes.

commands.name: heic-to-png
commands.title: HEIC to PNG
commands.description: Convert iPhone HEIC photos to lossless PNG images.

commands.name: heic-to-jpg
commands.title: HEIC to JPG
commands.description: Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG images that open anywhere.

commands.name: png-to-jpg
commands.title: PNG to JPG
commands.description: Convert PNG images to JPG, filling transparency with a solid colour.

commands.name: jpg-to-png
commands.title: JPG to PNG
commands.description: Convert JPG images to lossless PNG images.

commands.name: png-to-webp
commands.title: PNG to WebP
commands.description: Convert PNG images to WebP, lossy or lossless, keeping transparency.

commands.name: webp-to-png
commands.title: WebP to PNG
commands.description: Convert WebP images to PNG images that open anywhere.

commands.name: jpg-to-webp
commands.title: JPG to WebP
commands.description: Convert JPG images to WebP for smaller file sizes.

commands.name: webp-to-jpg
commands.title: WebP to JPG
commands.description: Convert WebP images to JPG for maximum compatibility.

commands.name: avif-to-png
commands.title: AVIF to PNG
commands.description: Convert AVIF images to PNG images that open anywhere.

commands.name: avif-to-jpg
commands.title: AVIF to JPG
commands.description: Convert AVIF images to JPG for universal sharing.

commands.name: avif-to-webp
commands.title: AVIF to WebP
commands.description: Convert AVIF images to WebP for broader web support.

commands.name: png-to-ico
commands.title: PNG to ICO
commands.description: Create a multi-size ICO favicon (16 to 256 px) from PNG images.

commands.name: svg-to-ico
commands.title: SVG to ICO
commands.description: Create a multi-size ICO favicon (16 to 256 px) from SVG files.

commands.name: jpg-to-ico
commands.title: JPG to ICO
commands.description: Create a multi-size ICO favicon (16 to 256 px) from JPG images.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
